n: After extensive research and testing to improve the safety factor of next-generation modules for their Mk2 series, engineers at C7 Aerospace got fed up with having to constantly find new recruits willing to test their prototypes, and decided to develop an autonomous AI capable of doing the same job, only with a lot less screaming over the comms link. n: QBE is Probodobodyne's latest development in probe miniaturization. Despite it's diminutive size, the QBE is a fully-functional and incredibly lightweight command unit. n: Kerbodyne engineers got fed up with having to contend with overly complicated staging arrays for lifting heavy payloads, and decided instead to just build a truly enormous engine of the highest efficiency. It's certainly got the power to match its size, and although it excels in its main role as a first-stage engine, the lack of structural hardpoints on its underside makes it quite less suitable for other purposes. Its price tag also seems to match its size, in fact.

t: 由于对要发射重型装备就不得不弄出超复杂分级队列的争执让人不胜其烦，坎巴拉动力公司的工程师们决定要制造一台真正的巨无霸引擎，用来得到超强动力。他们将四台坎巴拉动力KS-25火箭引擎捆在一起，然后就创造出了有史以来最大的火箭引擎，每台KS-25都拥有最高的室压，因为四个小型的喷管和燃烧室比一个大的好（太大会变成炸弹）。它的动力也毫无疑问对得起它的规格，然而它主要适合作为第一级引擎，因为其下方缺乏可连接节点，不怎么适合其他用途。顺便它的价钱也同样对得起它的规格。

n: This super heavy booster is designed to be recovered after jettisoning. Once recovered, it is refurbished and refueled for another launch.
s: This super heavy booster is designed to be recovered after jettisoning. Once recovered, it is refurbished and refueled for another launch.
t: 这款超重型助推器被设计为可以在分离后回收。一旦回收，它将被翻新并重新加注燃料用于另一次发射。
S1 SRB-KD25k“反冲”固体燃料助推器

n: When The O-10 Engine was first unveiled, it was regarded as one of those ideas that someone should have thought of a long time ago. This Engine responds to main throttle controls, but it consumes MonoPropellant instead of a Fuel+Oxidizer mix.

O-10“烟雾”单元推进燃料引擎

n: A small turbojet. Not very efficient, anemic thrust, but hey--it's cheap! And it's so cute...look at the little thing!

S3 KS-25“矢量”液体燃料引擎

n: The smaller sibling of the Mainsail, the Skipper's power rivals that of... large cities. Combining high thrust with reasonable efficiency, this engine excels when used as a mid-stage booster.
s: The smaller sibling of the Mainsail, the Skipper's power rivals that of... large cities. Combining high thrust with reasonable efficiency, this engine excels when used as a mid-stage booster.
t: 主帆更小的姊妹版，“船长”能提供的动力相当于……一座大型城市。强大的推力与合理的效率相结合使这款引擎适合作为中级阶段助推器使用。

n: A more reasonable engine for rough economic times, the Poodle engine doubles as a BBQ when at low power.
s: A more reasonable engine for rough economic times, the Poodle engine doubles as a BBQ when at low power.
t: 一款在囊中羞涩时价钱比较合理的引擎，“贵宾犬”引擎在低油门的时候还能兼作BBQ设备使用。

n: Kerbodyne's flagship engine, the KS-25 excels as a first stage engine through its high thrust-to-weight ratio and exceptional sea level efficiency. Kerbodyne engineers achieved this by running the engine in a staged combustion cycle and at extremely high chamber pressures. Special new alloys had to be invented to suppress the engine's tendency to become a bomb. The single version is designed with very durable components and high reusability, as well as higher gimbal range, but because of that is also heavier than its expendable counterpart used in first stage clusters.

t: 得益于其超高推重比和优秀的海平面推力，坎巴拉动力公司的旗舰产品KS-25特别适合作为第一级引擎。坎巴拉动力公司的工程师们将引擎设计为分级循环和极端室压才得到了如今的性能指标，而且采用了新发明的特种合金制造，以防止它变成一颗炸弹。该版本采用了非常耐用的构件和高度重复利用的材料，而且拥有更广的矢量调节范围。不过正因为如此，它比那些用于第一级的同类引擎更重。

n: After an intensive search for an engineer crazy enough to plan and build a revolutionary new engine type, researchers turned to renowned engineer Eumon Kerman, one of the top minds in the industry. t: 由一个十足疯狂的工程师计划并打造出来的革命性新型引擎，在经过短时间高强度的研究之后，研究者们转而向一位知名工程师求助——业内翘楚Eumon Kerman。然而很不幸的是他搞砸了，于是我们最后只搞出来这玩意。嘿！至少如果你需要更好的操控性能，它跟其他大型引擎（极限火箭产品）在一起的时候运行得挺好的。很抱歉的是，不接受团购。

n: Although criticized by some due to their not insignificant use of so-called "pieces found lying about", the LV-T series engines have proven themselves as comparatively reliable. The T30 model boasts a failure and rattly bits ratio below the 50% mark, this has been considered a major improvement over previous models by engineers and LV-T enthusiasts.
s: Although criticized by some due to their not insignificant use of so-called "pieces found lying about", the LV-T series engines have proven themselves as comparatively reliable. t: 虽然有些人用不是那么无关紧要的字眼如“碎了一地”来批评它，但LV-T系列证明了它们是相当可靠的。T30型号令人骄傲地取得了将失效和松动概率都降到50%以下的成绩。这被工程师们和LV-T的铁杆粉丝们看作是一大进步。

n: The LV-T45 engine was considered a breakthrough in the LV-T series due to its Thrust Vectoring feature. The LV-T45 can deflect its thrust to aid in craft control. All these added mechanics however, make for a slightly smaller and heavier engine in comparison with other LV-T models.
s: The LV-T45 engine was considered a breakthrough in the LV-T series due to its Thrust Vectoring feature. The LV-T45 can deflect its thrust to aid in craft control. All these added mechanics however, make for a slightly smaller and heavier engine in comparison with other LV-T models.
t: 因为具有矢量推进特性，LV-T45引擎被认为是LV-T系列的一大突破。LV-T45能够偏转自身推力的方向，协助航天器操控。但是，它的所有附加结构让它和其他LV-T型号比起来要稍微小一点儿，也更重一点儿。

n: A monster of an engine for heavy lifting purposes, the Mainsail's power rivals that of entire small nations.
s: A monster of an engine for heavy lifting purposes, the Mainsail's power rivals that of entire small nations.
t: 引擎中的怪兽，为重型升空用途而造，主帆提供的动力和一整个小型国家旗鼓相当。

LV-N“神经元”原子火箭发动机

n: Despite the big scary trefoil painted onto the side of this engine, its radioactive exhaust, and tendency to overheat, the LV-N Atomic Rocket Motor is harmless. Mostly. Note that the LV-N is the only LV series engine to run solely on Liquid Fuel - the future is glowing bright!
s: Despite the big scary trefoil painted onto the side of this engine, its radioactive exhaust, and tendency to overheat, the LV-N Atomic Rocket Motor is harmless. Mostly. Note that the LV-N is the only LV series engine to run solely on Liquid Fuel - the future is glowing bright!
t: 尽管这款引擎的侧面画着巨大骇人的辐射标志，喷管有放射性而且特别容易过热，但是LV-N原子火箭发动机是无害的——在大多数情况下是这样，嗯。另外要注意LV-N是LV系列里唯一一款只消耗液体燃料的引擎——前景一片光明！

n: Adapted to appease engineers who were outraged at the lack of control rocket engines usually provide, the radial mounted LV-1R offers an appealing solution: "Just add more". Point away from face.
s: Adapted to appease engineers who were outraged at the lack of control rocket engines usually provide, the radial mounted LV-1R offers an appealing solution: "Just add more".  Point away from face.
t: 为了适当安抚那些因为通常提供的火箭引擎缺乏控制而暴走的工程师们，这款径向悬挂的LV-1R提供了一个具有吸气力的解决方案：“尽管添加更多”。完美地转移了重点。

n: What is this, an engine for ants?
s: What is this, an engine for ants?
t: 这是什么？为蚂蚁打造的引擎吗？

n: The Toroidal Aerospike is a huge breakthrough from C7 Aerospace. While heavier than previous models, with its heavy-duty exhaust nozzle, the Aerospike makes up for it with an efficient burning of fuel at all altitudes.
s: The Toroidal Aerospike is a huge breakthrough from C7 Aerospace. While heavier than previous models, with its heavy-duty exhaust nozzle, the Aerospike makes up for it with an efficient burning of fuel at all altitudes.
t: 环塞引擎是来自C7航天部门的重大突破。虽然比前代型号相比更重，但却拥有结实耐用的喷口，它填补了在所有海拔高度上高效燃烧燃料的空白。

n: T-1 Toroidal Aerospike "Dart" Liquid Fuel Engine
s: T-1 Toroidal Aerospike "Dart" Liquid Fuel Engine
t: T-1“飞镖”环塞液体燃料引擎

n: The 48-7S may be small, but it packs quite a punch for its size. This little engine is a testament to how larger does not always mean more advanced, at least according to Rockomax's marketing department. The box it comes in is pretty cool, in any case.
s: The 48-7S may be small, but it packs quite a punch for its size. This little engine is a testament to how larger does not always mean more advanced, at least according to Rockomax's marketing department. The box it comes in is pretty cool, in any case.

n: A high bypass turbofan engine. This engine works best at low cruising speeds and altitudes.
s: A high bypass turbofan engine. This engine works best at low cruising speeds and altitudes.
t: 大涵道比涡扇引擎。这款引擎在低巡航速度和全海拔飞行中表现最佳。

n: A highly advanced turbine engine using space-grade materials for very high performance. This new model features the latest in thrust vectoring and compression technology and is designed to operate best at higher altitudes and speeds. The advanced turbo ramjet design bleeds air around the compressor at high speed allowing a far maximum speed than regular jet engines, so engineers from C7 Aerospace assured us all those leaks are intentional.
s: A highly advanced turbine engine using space-grade materials for very high performance. This new model features the latest in thrust vectoring and compression technology and is designed to operate best at higher altitudes and speeds. The advanced turbo ramjet design bleeds air around the compressor at high speed allowing a far maximum speed than regular jet engines, so engineers from C7 Aerospace assured us all those leaks are intentional.
t: 极其先进的涡轮风扇引擎，使用太空级材料制成，拥有极其高超的性能。这款全新的型号体现了矢量推进和空压技术的最新成果，为更高的海拔和更快的速度达到最佳作业而设计。它先进的涡轮冲压设计可以在高速状态下榨取空压机周围的空气，远远超越当前主流喷气式引擎所能达到的极限速度。因此，C7航天的工程师们信誓旦旦的向我们保证，那些泄露事故都是人为造成的。

n: Tiny engine! But very useful, good for craft where larger radial engines won't fit, or when you want more control in combination with large lifter engines.
s: Tiny engine! But very useful, good for craft where larger radial engines won't fit, or when you want more control in combination with large lifter engines.
t: 袖珍引擎！但是非常有用，十分适用于那些不适合安装大块头径向引擎的航天器，或者当你想和发射级的大型引擎一起使用以便控制的情况下。

n: By emitting ionized xenon gas through a small thruster port, Dawn can produce incredibly efficient propulsion, but with a downside of very low thrust and high energy usage. According to ISP Electronics sales reps, the rumours of this engine being powered by "dark magic" are largely exaggerated.
s: By emitting ionized xenon gas through a small thruster port, Dawn can produce incredibly efficient propulsion, but with a downside of very low thrust and high energy usage. According to ISP Electronics sales reps, the rumours of this engine being powered by "dark magic" are largely exaggerated.
t: 通过将电离的氙气通过小型推进器端口，“黎明”能够产生难以置信的高效推力，而其缺点只有推力非常低和能耗过高。考虑到ISP电子的销售业绩，那些关于这些引擎是由“黑魔法”驱动的谣言未免太夸大其词了。

n: A high performance jet engine with a variable geometry thrust vectoring nozzle and an afterburner for extra thrust.
s: A high performance jet engine with a variable geometry thrust vectoring nozzle and an afterburner for extra thrust.
t: 高性能的喷气式引擎，带有可调的几何形推进器，矢量喷管，以及提供额外推力的加力燃烧室。

n: New advances in surge control technology made The Z-4K, the largest battery pack ever put into production a reality. While Zaltonic admits intense electrical discharges can be really cool, shorting the Z-4K's contacts should probably be avoided.
s: New advances in surge control technology made The Z-4K, the largest battery pack ever put into production a reality. While Zaltonic admits intense electrical discharges can be really cool, shorting the Z-4K's contacts should probably be avoided.
t: 电涌控制技术的全新进步让Z-4K，这款最大号的电池组的生产变为现实。虽然泽通电子也觉得剧烈的电场放电很酷，他们还是应该会尽量避免涉及需要短路Z-4K的合同的。

n: A small canister filled with what appears to be solid rocket fuel. Although not much of a step forward in terms of raw power, Kerbal Scientists have slowly warmed up to the Sepratron I's many uses, such as pushing things away. For best results, angle before use.
s: A small canister filled with what appears to be solid rocket fuel. Although not much of a step forward in terms of raw power, Kerbal Scientists have slowly warmed up to the Sepratron I's many uses, such as pushing things away. For best results, angle before use.

n: Our engineers insisted on a way to reuse Mk2 parts on the new Fuselage system. Manufacturing a streamlined adapter despite the considerable difference of the two cross sections required quite a radical design. It is often used as a slide on Take Your Kids to Work Day.
s: Our engineers insisted on a way to reuse Mk2 parts on the new Fuselage system. Manufacturing a streamlined adapter despite the considerable difference of the two cross sections required quite a radical design. It is often used as a slide on Take Your Kids to Work Day.

n: The VR-N1ER Veer-Governor, or "Vernor" Engine is an attitude control thruster. These motors are linked to RCS controls, but are powered by a Fuel+Oxidizer mix, making them significantly more powerful than MonoPropellant-powered RCS thrusters. They are fairly more bulky in comparison though, and feature only one nozzle facing outwards, although most agree that is an acceptable trade-off for the additional punch they pack.

n: While considered by some to be little more than "a trash bin full o' boom", The RT-5 can be seen in use at many space programs, perhaps possibly because it is the only option for many space programs, but nevertheless, this small booster provides a nice kick to lift small payloads to considerable heights. n: While trying to solve the initial issue with the FTX-1 series fuel line, an engineer at FLOOYD Dynamics had an ingenious thought - what if you failed to attach a fuel pipe at all? t: 任何更精确地控制火箭引擎内部持续不断爆炸的领域的新进展都是令人赞叹的。当然，也是价格不菲的。

n: Specialized construction techniques provide new ways of attaching things together, and detaching things on purpose.
s: Specialized construction techniques provide new ways of attaching things together, and detaching things on purpose.
t: 专业建造学提供了将东西固定在一起或是把它们分开的新方法。

n: We're fairly certain no one will ever need more than 64kw of power for anything.
s: We're fairly certain no one will ever need more than 64kw of power for anything.
t: 我们非常肯定，没有人会需要超过64千瓦的电能。

n: Why wonder about what's over the next hill when you can wonder about what's under it?
s: Why wonder about what's over the next hill when you can wonder about what's under it?
t: 如果你能搞清楚山下面是什么，为什么还要费心去想山后面是什么呢？

n: Warning: May contain traces of sentience.
s: Warning: May contain traces of sentience.
t: 警告：可能带有靠直觉来的痕迹。

n: Nuclear engines don't burn fuel, they totally annihilate it. We just hope it doesn't begin any conflicts.
s: Nuclear engines don't burn fuel, they totally annihilate it. We just hope it doesn't begin any conflicts.
t: 核引擎不燃烧燃料，只会让燃料彻底湮灭。我们只希望这不会造成任何冲突。

n: These new construction techniques allow for craft designs that were considered insane not too long ago... and still are. But they're now possible!
s: These new construction techniques allow for craft designs that were considered insane not too long ago... and still are. But they're now possible!
t: 这些新的制造技术使我们可以实现不久以前还被认为过于疯狂的航空器设计，这些设计现在也有些疯狂。但是毕竟已经可以实现了！

n: Freedom to roam as far as curiosity will take you, or as long as batteries last.
s: Freedom to roam as far as curiosity will take you, or as long as batteries last.
t: 自由就是任由好奇心把你带去任何地方，当然要在电池续航能力允许范围内。

s: A large 1.25 container, capable of storing a wide variety of equipment but specifically designed for storing precision scientific instruments and protecting them from the rigours of launch, travel, and landing on distance planets Warning: Contents not pressurized. Risk of Snack Bag explosion >99%.

n: A huge nosecone to help make 3.75 rockets cut through the air.
s: A huge nosecone to help make 3.75 rockets cut through the air.
t: 用于让3.75米火箭顺利突破天际的巨型头锥。

n: The latest breakthroughs that are driving motor technology forwards, and in reverse, and steering too.
s: The latest breakthroughs that are driving motor technology forwards, and in reverse, and steering too.
t: 推动马达技术，以及倒车和转向技术方面进步的最新进展。

n: Explore novel fields of science that we didn't even know were there.
s: Explore novel fields of science that we didn't even know were there.
t: 探索全新的科学领域，我们之前甚至不知道这些领域的存在。

n: The very latest in electrical systems technology. Our engineers are buzzing with excitement over it. They also seem to glow in the dark now. Fascinating!
s: The very latest in electrical systems technology. Our engineers are buzzing with excitement over it. They also seem to glow in the dark now. Fascinating!
t: 电气系统技术的最前沿领域。我们的工程师对此兴奋不已，顺便他们现在好像都变成夜光的了。不可思议！

n: Improvements in remote control technology for a new generation of probe designs.
s: Improvements in remote control technology for a new generation of probe designs.
t: 远程控制技术的进步带来了新一代探测器设计。

n: Push your aircraft to the upper limits of airspeed and sanity.
s: Push your aircraft to the upper limits of airspeed and sanity.
t: 将你的飞行器推向空速和理智的极限。

n: Despite the threatening appearance of the green metablobs shot out of the Nanolathing Injectors, none can argue the fact that Kerbals have indeed developed technologies at least just as dangerous as this one.
s: Despite the threatening appearance of the green metablobs shot out of the Nanolathing Injectors, none can argue the fact that Kerbals have indeed developed technologies at least just as dangerous as this one.
t: 尽管纳米加工注塑机有时候会喷射出一些看上去很可怕的大块绿色物质，但我们得承认，坎巴拉人以前也曾经研究过至少和这个差不多危险的技术。

n: Advances in construction technology enabled new breakthroughs in aerospace materials.
s: Advances in construction technology enabled new breakthroughs in aerospace materials.
t: 建造技术的进步带来了空气动力学材料方面的突破。

n: Turns out, it's not science fiction.
s: Turns out, it's not science fiction.
t: 原来，这不是科幻小说啊。

n: Maximize your energy production and storage potential by maximizing the size of the electrical components on your vessels.
s: Maximize your energy production and storage potential by maximizing the size of the electrical components on your vessels.
t: 通过最大化航天器上的电子元件尺寸，达到最大化的能量生成和储存能力。

n: Hopefully these won't become obsolete in the next couple of months.
s: Hopefully these won't become obsolete in the next couple of months.
t: 希望几个月之后这些依然没有过时。

n: Lightweight and strong! and don't worry, we're sure the glue will dry off in no time.
s: Lightweight and strong! and don't worry, we're sure the glue will dry off in no time.
t: 重量轻，强度大！别担心，胶水一会儿就干了。

n: Maximize the payload capacity of your spacecraft by maximizing the size of your spacecraft.
s: Maximize the payload capacity of your spacecraft by maximizing the size of your spacecraft.
t: 通过最大化飞船体积，实现最大化其载荷容量。

n: New breakthroughs in engine and intake development to enable flying through the upper reaches of the atmosphere.
s: New breakthroughs in engine and intake development to enable flying through the upper reaches of the atmosphere.
t: 引擎和进气道领域的新进步让我们能在大气层的最高处飞行。

n: Winged flight technology is soaring to unprecedented heights. It could even be said that it's properly taking off now.
s: Winged flight technology is soaring to unprecedented heights. It could even be said that it's properly taking off now.
t: 有翼飞行技术正达到前所未有的高度。甚至可以说，现在已经顺利起飞了。

n: Massive engines require massive fuel storage solutions.
s: Massive engines require massive fuel storage solutions.
t: 大型引擎需要大型燃料存储解决方案。

n: The absolute cutting-edge in aerospace technology. Quite literally, some of those edges are very sharp. Handle with care.
s: The absolute cutting-edge in aerospace technology. Quite literally, some of those edges are very sharp. Handle with care.
t: 航空技术真正的尖端。说真的，有些地方真的很尖。操作的时候一定要小心。

n: We can't think of anything that could go wrong with letting an experimental AI handle every aspect of a mission.
s: We can't think of anything that could go wrong with letting an experimental AI handle every aspect of a mission.
t: 让一个试验阶段的人工智能来掌控任务的方方面面会有什么问题呢，我们实在想不出来。

n: The rumours of probe-led world domination are greatly exaggerated.
s: The rumours of probe-led world domination are greatly exaggerated.
t: 关于探测器将会统治世界的传言实在是太夸张了。

n: Scientific advancements allow new advanced technologies for advancing Science.
s: Scientific advancements allow new advanced technologies for advancing Science.
t: 随着科学进步，发展科学的技术也有了新的进展。

n: Wheel technology is just rolling along now. You could even say our engineers are on a roll with it.
s: Wheel technology is just rolling along now. You could even say our engineers are on a roll with it.
t: 车轮技术已经在向前滚动前进了。你也可以说我们的工程师们现在鸿运滚滚。

n: An advancement in spacecraft construction so revolutionary, you won't even mind that its naming was wildly inaccurate.
s: An advancement in spacecraft construction so revolutionary, you won't even mind that its naming was wildly inaccurate.
t: 飞船建造领域革命性的进展让你忘记了它的名字跟内容其实毫不相关。

n: While ever-larger rockets may not be the answer every time, for all other times, we've developed these.
s: While ever-larger rockets may not be the answer every time, for all other times, we've developed these.
t: 尽管把火箭造得越来越大可能不是永恒的答案，但我们还是研发了这个。

n: Experience the warm glow of the latest in electrical technology. Figuratively, of course, and maybe also quite literally as well. Actually, try to avoid direct exposure.
s: Experience the warm glow of the latest in electrical technology. Figuratively, of course, and maybe also quite literally as well. Actually, try to avoid direct exposure.
t: 来体验最新的电子科技温暖的光芒吧。这当然是个比喻，不过也可以说是现实。当然要小心，避免直接受到照射。

n: As convenient as it is fashionable. This part actually won a modern-art design prize.
s: As convenient as it is fashionable. This part actually won a modern-art design prize.
t: 有多时尚就有多方便。跟你说实话，我们靠这个部件赢得了现代艺术设计奖。

n: This modern cockpit includes space for three crew members, and integrated RCS thrusters.
s: This modern cockpit includes space for three crew members, and integrated RCS thrusters.
t: 这款现代化的指令舱采用可重复使用的设计。它宽敞的舱室最多能容纳3名乘员。现在还附赠RCS。

n: Often, and mistakenly used for playing ball games.
s: Often, and mistakenly used for playing ball games.
t: 这东西经常会被误用来当球玩。
一个非传统形状（但是确实很顺手）的燃料箱。

n: Magnetic fields are all around us. Kerbal scientists know that learning about the magnetic field of a celestial body can yield all sorts of interesting insights into what's going on inside it - but spacecraft also emit magnetic fields, especially when operating their electronics and electromechnical actuators. And for some reason, the other engineers don't just want to turn off the entire spacecraft or build it out of plastic. So, as a fall back position, Experimental Engineering group has stuck this sensitive magnetometer on an extensible boom. Warning: Warranty on the boom will be voided if you try to use it anyplace besides the vaccuum of space.
s: Magnetic fields are all around us.  Kerbal scientists know that learning about the magnetic field of a celestial body can yield all sorts of interesting insights into what's going on inside it - but spacecraft also emit magnetic fields, especially when operating their electronics and electromechnical actuators.  And for some reason, the other engineers don't just want to turn off the entire spacecraft or build it out of plastic.  So, as a fall back position, Experimental Engineering group has stuck this sensitive magnetometer on an extensible boom.  Warning:  Warranty on the boom will be voided if you try to use it anyplace besides the vaccuum of space.
t:
我们周围到处都是磁场。Kerbal的科学家们都知道，了解天体的磁场可让我们对其内部的情况产生各种各样有趣的见解。但航天器也会发射磁场，尤其是在操作其电子设备以及机电传动器的时候。

出于某些原因，工程师不想关闭整个航天器的动力，也不想用塑料来进行建造，因此，实验工程小组通过将此灵敏的磁强计粘贴在可伸缩的臂杆上，从而解决了这个问题。

警告：在真空空间以外的地方使用不承诺保修。

n: The Moho Planetary Observer combines the function of many parts in one, to help make sure the searing heat of its primary mission target is distributed and dissipated without harming its critical control functionality.
s: The Moho Planetary Observer combines the function of many parts in one, to help make sure the searing heat of its primary mission target is distributed and dissipated without harming its critical control functionality.
t: Moho行星观测仪将多个部件的功能结合在一起，以确保分散或消散主任务目标灼热的热量，同时不损害其关键的控制功能。

n: Probodobodyne has meticulously curated and assembled this case full of various devices and knicknacks, all of which are useful for science experiments. Despite observations to the contrary, we feel that the inability for Kerbal astronauts to find a good use for the collapsible top hat and magic wand to be more of an issue with lack of creativity, rather than a case of items being left inside from a prior use case.

n: The Moho Transfer Module houses a control core and a generously sized xenon tank. Perfect for transporting large scientific payloads anywhere where large amounts of deltaV are required.

n: Ever wanted to deploy small items into space such as Cubesats, ion-powered Probes or Kerbals? This is just the part for you! (Disclaimer: C7 Aerospace does not condone the deployment of Kerbals into space via Cargo Bays.)
s: Ever wanted to deploy small items into space such as Cubesats, ion-powered Probes or Kerbals? This is just the part for you! (Disclaimer: C7 Aerospace does not condone the deployment of Kerbals into space via Cargo Bays.)

n: The Mk12-R is a half sized radial mount version of the Mk25. This "Drogue" parachute is small, deploys high up, and certainly not enough to stop you smashing into the ground on its own, but useful for slowing craft down before the deployment of your main chutes.
s: The Mk12-R is a half sized radial mount version of the Mk25. This "Drogue" parachute is small, deploys high up, and certainly not enough to stop you smashing into the ground on its own, but useful for slowing craft down before the deployment of your main chutes.
t: Mk12-R是Mk25型号尺寸减半的径向版本。这款“减速”降落伞很小，展开高度很高，并且肯定不能避免硬着陆，但可以用来在主降落伞打开前减缓下落速度。

n: The Mk16 Parachute might be considered by some to be little more than a random stitching together of the surplus parts it is, in fact, made from. But the fact remains that the Mk16 has been widely accepted as a generally better alternative to being in freefall.
s: The Mk16 Parachute might be considered by some to be little more than a random stitching together of the surplus parts it is, in fact, made from. But the fact remains that the Mk16 has been widely accepted as a generally better alternative to being in freefall.
t: 可能会有人认为Mk16降落伞不过是把多余的部件随便拼凑起来的产物。但事实上人们还是公认使用MK16比自由落体强得多了。

n: The Mk16-XL Parachute is a double-sized variant of the Mk16, now with only 50% of the structural integrity!
s: The Mk16-XL Parachute is a double-sized variant of the Mk16, now with only 50% of the structural integrity!
t: Mk16-XL降落伞是Mk16的双倍大小版本，但是结构可靠性仅有后者的50%！

n: A parachute comparable to the Mk16 chute, but which is placed radially instead of attached on top of something.
s: A parachute comparable to the Mk16 chute, but which is placed radially instead of attached on top of something.
t: 和Mk16相比，它算得上是个真正的降落伞，但安装方式是径向的，而不是在物体的正上方。

n: The Mk25 is what's known as a "Drogue" parachute - small, deploys high up, and certainly not enough to stop you smashing into the ground on its own, but useful for slowing heavy craft down before the deployment of your main chutes.
s: The Mk25 is what's known as a "Drogue" parachute - small, deploys high up, and certainly not enough to stop you smashing into the ground on its own, but useful for slowing heavy craft down before the deployment of your main chutes.

n: Originally a defective Clamp-O-Tron docking port, engineers soon discovered it had great potential as a structural element.

n: A heat resistant service bay, ideal for protecting delicate instruments or stowing small service components such as RCS tanks, batteries, etc.
s: A heat resistant service bay, ideal for protecting delicate instruments or stowing small service components such as RCS tanks, batteries, etc.

n: A relay antenna with automatic store and forward capabilities as well as advanced pathfinding algorithms.
s: A relay antenna with automatic store and forward capabilities as well as advanced pathfinding algorithms.
t: 具备自动信息存储和转发功能的中继天线，采用先进的寻径算法。

s: The recent discovery of a third law of physics made it possible for STEADLER Corps engineers to produce these small monopropellant thrusters, to help with attitude control and linear motion. n: The Illuminator Mk2 is an extra-wide beam, low-power Illuminator, for lighting up large swaths of whatever you wish. However, its beam does not shine very far.
s: The Illuminator Mk2 is an extra-wide beam, low-power Illuminator, for lighting up large swaths of whatever you wish. However, its beam does not shine very far.
t: 照明装置Mk2的光束很粗，功率较低，能够为您照亮一大片区域。但是，光柱的照射距离并不是很远。

n: The Illuminator Mk1 from RKEA projects a strong beam of photons in its prograde direction, increasing the brightness of surfaces exposed to the beam (it's a big flashlight).
s: The Illuminator Mk1 from RKEA projects a strong beam of photons in its prograde direction, increasing the brightness of surfaces exposed to the beam (it's a big flashlight).

n: The TVR-200 Stack Bi-Coupler is a simple method for splitting one rocket into two - WITHOUT the disastrous consequences of doing it the normal (explosive) way.
s: The TVR-200 Stack Bi-Coupler is a simple method for splitting one rocket into two - WITHOUT the disastrous consequences of doing it the normal (explosive) way.
t: TVR-200双向连接器是将一个火箭一分为二的简单方法，并且能避免用常规手段（比如爆炸）带来的灾难性后果。

n: The Stack Tricoupler! If your stack is lacking in awesomeness, this is the tool for you! Just remember that this is not a decoupler, and won't separate stages.
